lines.text: Baasha fortified Ramah to block Judah, so Asa sent silver and gold from the temple and palace treasuries to Ben-hadad.
Ben-hadad's commanders conquered Ijon, Dan, Abel-maim and the store cities of Naphtali, so Baasha abandoned his work at Ramah.
Asa and the men of Judah carried off the stones of Ramah and built up Geba and Mizpah.
Hanani the seer told Asa he relied on the king of Aram, so Asa put him in the stocks.
Asa's feet became diseased in the thirty-ninth year, and he sought only priests, then died in the forty-first year.
